correctness.rationale: Spectral diagonalization gives exact preconditioner eigenvalues n−κ+n(κ−1) Ubar and n−1+n(κ−1)Ubar. Each independent spherical squared coordinate U has Beta(1/2,(n−1)/2), yielding SPD exactly when mean(nU)>(κ−n)/(κ−1), and the incomplete-beta one-probe failure. At κ=n the preconditioned condition number blows up as 1/(n² Ubar); the Dirichlet convolution of r x^(−1/2) densities gives tail t^(−r/2) with exact supplied constant and E K^q finite iff q<r/2, including divergence at equality. Law of large numbers and CLT prove the two limit orders, with chi-square limit in n. Independently verified the n=3 κ=9 half-probability and four exact critical-tail constants. Only one-spike spherical probes and exact arithmetic are covered.
residual_risks: Stochastic trace probes independent and spherical, one spike, no roundoff or solver trajectory. Simulations support but do not prove stochastic asymptotics.
